Title: Azure Kubernetes service (AKS) control plane audit logging is now in preview

Body.Content:
Audit Logging in AKS is now available in preview. Use it to keep a chronological record of calls that have been made to the Kubernetes API server, also known as the control plane. Use audit logging to investigate suspicious API requests, collect statistics, or create monitoring alerts for unwanted API calls. 

 

Learn more.
